company.name: Fjord Content Agency
company.description: Content marketing agency producing social, blog and newsletter content for B2B and consumer clients.

message.text: Saw your post on agency automations. We produce around 300 pieces of content a month for 18 clients and the repurposing and scheduling is a bottleneck we cannot hire our way out of. We have set aside a budget for this quarter. Could you do a call on Thursday or Friday?
